evals.prompt: Context is getting full; prepare for /clear. All my subagents have returned.
evals.expected_output: Asks or records that no agent is running, runs `python3 -I dev/handoff.py write --agents-done` (dry-run first when the template changed), then `check --agents-done --json`, reports go/no-go with the finding list and prints the `claude -n <name> "..."` start command; never edits task_plan.md by hand.
expectations: Runs dev/handoff.py write before check and reports both exit codes
Reports go only when check exits 0 and lists every P1/P2 finding otherwise
Prints the start command from dev/handoff.py start-command
Tells the user to type /session-resume <name> only after /clear, never after the start command
Does not hand-edit task_plan.md, progress.md or the HANDOFF file

evals.prompt: Checkpoint the session: a merge is still in progress and I have one implementer still running.
evals.expected_output: Reports no-go: refuses to assert --agents-done while an agent runs, runs check without the flag, shows H.git-op-in-progress and H.agents-unconfirmed with their fix hints, and tells the user what to finish before /clear.
expectations: Does not pass --agents-done while an agent is running
Names H.git-op-in-progress and H.agents-unconfirmed with fix hints
Returns no-go and does not tell the user to /clear

evals.prompt: handoff: the next session should start as ccm-20261015 and the user now owes R-172 (D59).
evals.expected_output: Edits references/handoff-template.md (owner section), copies it to the .agents mirror, confirms R-172 is an `owner user` line of `## Open requests` (the generated Pending user line carries it), runs write --dry-run to show the diff, then write and check, and prints the start command naming ccm-20261015.
expectations: Changes the template rather than the generated block
Puts the user-owed item in `## Open requests` as an `owner user` R-n line, never in the template
Syncs the .agents/skills/session-handoff mirror after the template edit
Shows the write --dry-run diff before writing
